items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: He was playing there when I left, and then Braud was playing bass.

ctx.x: Oh, I didn't know he worked regularly with Ory.
Oh yeah. He was playing there when I left, and then Braud was playing bass.

Ory had such an unbelievable changeover of clarinet players, as we said before. But then he started changing everybody around. He had trumpet players, Blakeney and Teddy Buckner and Alvin Alcorn, Red Mack...
